map.f=50mm：M=250/50=5×。焦距越长倍率越小、视野越稳，适合长时间阅读: f=50mm: M=250/50=5×. A longer focal length gives a lower magnification and a steadier field, which suits long reading sessions.
map.与横向放大率有何区别？: How does it differ from lateral magnification?
map.角放大率比较的是视角（M=N/f），横向放大率比较像高与物高（m=-di/do）: Angular magnification compares visual angles (M=N/f), while lateral magnification compares image height to object height (m=-di/do); they apply in different situations.
map.f 太短会怎样？: What happens if f is too short?
map.M 增大但像差与畸变加剧、工作距变短，常规助视放大镜多在 2×–10× 之间。: M increases, but aberrations and distortion grow and the working distance shortens; ordinary low-vision magnifiers fall between 2× and 10×.

map.角放大率 M=θ′/θ：像对眼睛的张角 θ′ 与物在明视距离张角 θ 之比，描述: Angular magnification M=θ′/θ: the ratio of the angle θ′ the image subtends at the eye to the angle θ the object subtends at the near point, describing how much bigger a magnifier or eyepiece makes an object appear.
map.简单放大镜 M≈25 cm / f（f 焦距，单位 cm）。M>1 为正立放大；: For a simple magnifier M≈25 cm / f (f is the focal length in cm). M>1 gives an upright enlarged image; the angular magnification of a telescope is ≈−f_obj/f_eye.
